contexts.text: Their delights which have been taken away are signified by... hedad ().
The deprivation of heavenly delight is signified by hedad not hedad ().
By hedad () is signified the end, when upon finishing the vintage and gathering in the harvest they were wont to triumph and make a shouting; but here it = to lament.
That there is no longer any joy from any spiritual love, is signified by he shall not tread hedad (). The triumph of those who tread the winepress is meant by hedad.
